working_definition: P15 'tail' attached to Tm29/TmY5a clusters (cells of P15 cluster 88 not classified as Tm29); the authors' call is 'probably immature Tm29/TmY5a neurons'.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Immature form of a transmedullary neuron (Konstantinides et al., 2022).

justification: Grouped call. Immature Tm29 (FBbt:00052328) is_a immature transmedullary neuron; immature transmedullary Y neuron (parent of immature TmY5a) is_a immature transmedullary neuron. Verification flagged because of the authors' 'probably' hedge.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Immature form of the transmedullary neuron Tm29 (Konstantinides et al., 2022). It is a Notch OFF hemilineage secondary neuron, born from a medulla forming neuroblast during the Erm/Ey temporal window (Konstantinides et al., 2022).

Immature form of the transmedullary Y neuron TmY5a (Konstantinides et al., 2022). It is a Notch OFF hemilineage secondary neuron, born from a medulla forming neuroblast during the Erm/Ey temporal window (Konstantinides et al., 2022).

recommendation: Broad match to immature transmedullary neuron; members Tm29, TmY5a.
